SELECT
    ROW(
        id,
        revision,
        shipment_id,
        item_id,
        operation_id,
        container_type_code,
        container_ownership,
        container_number,
        type,
        hazardous
    )::public.transportation_v4 AS transportation,
    '' COLLATE "C" AS sort_key
FROM transportations
WHERE transportations.organization_id = $1::UUID
  AND EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM transportations AS route_owner

JOIN shipment_route_segments AS shared
    ON shared.organization_id = route_owner.organization_id
   AND shared.shipment_id = route_owner.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN route_segments AS local
    ON local.organization_id = route_owner.organization_id
   AND local.transportation_id = route_owner.id
   AND local.id = shared.id


WHERE route_owner.organization_id = transportations.organization_id
  AND route_owner.id = transportations.id
  AND ((shared.mode COLLATE "C" = ANY($2::TEXT[])))

)
ORDER BY id ASC
LIMIT $3::INTEGER;

route_values:force_custom_plan.query:
SELECT (candidate.value)::TEXT AS value, COALESCE(MIN((candidate.label)::TEXT), '') AS label
FROM (
SELECT ((local.document #>> '{rail,destination_station,id}')::UUID) AS value, (concat_ws(' · ', local.document #>> '{rail,destination_station,name}', local.document #>> '{rail,destination_station,esr_code}')) AS label, organization_id
FROM route_segments AS local

) AS candidate
WHERE candidate.organization_id = $1::UUID
  AND EXISTS (
SELECT 1
FROM transportations

JOIN shipment_route_segments AS shared
    ON shared.organization_id = transportations.organization_id
   AND shared.shipment_id = transportations.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN route_segments AS local
    ON local.organization_id = transportations.organization_id
   AND local.transportation_id = transportations.id
   AND local.id = shared.id


WHERE transportations.organization_id = candidate.organization_id
  AND ((local.document #>> '{rail,destination_station,id}')::UUID) = candidate.value
  AND (TRUE)

)
  AND candidate.value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY candidate.value
ORDER BY candidate.value
LIMIT $2::INTEGER;
